Bayesian missing and spurious edge prediction and evaluation

predict_edges.Rd

Computes model-averaged Bayesian posterior edge probabilities for candidate missing or spurious links using flat/nested SBMs or uncertain-network models, and evaluates binary link-prediction performance with exact tie-aware ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier score, and ROC/PR curves.

Usage

predict_edges(x, candidates, nsamples = 100L, burnin = 50L, thin = 1L,
  nested = TRUE, degree_corrected = TRUE,
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, epsilon = 1e-8)

evaluate_edge_prediction(scores, labels, threshold = 0.5)

Arguments

x

A rgraphtool_graph, a fitted rgraphtool_block_state or rgraphtool_nested_block_state, or a rgraphtool_uncertain_block_state.

candidates

Two-column integer matrix or data.frame of 1-based candidate vertex pairs (u, v) to score.

nsamples, burnin, thin

Posterior MCMC sample count, burn-in sweeps, and thinning interval.

nested, degree_corrected, degree_prior

SBM prior options used when x is a raw graph.

self_loops

Whether self-loops are valid candidate dyads.

epsilon

Multiplicity summation convergence tolerance.

scores

Numeric vector of predicted edge scores/probabilities, or a rgraphtool_edge_prediction object.

labels

Binary ground-truth labels (0/1 or logical) with at least one positive and one negative example.

threshold

Classification threshold for precision, recall, F1, and accuracy.

Value

predict_edges() returns a rgraphtool_edge_prediction containing a predictions data.frame (from, to, prob, log_prob, and observed or conditional_prob).

evaluate_edge_prediction() returns a rgraphtool_edge_evaluation containing roc_auc, pr_auc, precision, recall, f1, accuracy, brier, confusion, and full roc and pr curve data.frames.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2018). Reconstructing networks with unknown and heterogeneous errors. Physical Review X 8, 041011. doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.8.041011

See also

measured_block_state, edge_probabilities, demo("uncertain_reconstruction")

Examples

g <- graph_create(12, directed = FALSE)
e <- rbind(t(combn(1:6, 2)), t(combn(7:12, 2)))
graph_add_edges(g, e[-1, , drop = FALSE])
cands <- rbind(e[1, ], c(1L, 12L))
set.seed(1)
pred <- predict_edges(g, cands, nsamples = 20L, burnin = 10L)
evaluate_edge_prediction(pred, c(1L, 0L))
#> <rgraphtool_edge_evaluation>
#>   ROC-AUC: 1.0000 | PR-AUC: 1.0000 | Brier: 0.0042
#>   At threshold 0.50 -> Precision: 1.0000 | Recall: 1.0000 | F1: 1.0000 | Acc: 1.0000
